notes.title: Early Access - Turn-Based Carnival Update
notes.notes:

We are happy to announce our newest patch including improvements in Tutorial and Campaign modes. Have fun!

Language Updates:

   Added French and Polish localizations


Tutorial Updates:

   Fixed Tutorial map paddings
   Improved order animations in Step 3
   Fixed zoom-out problem in Step 4
   Enhanced pointer hand animation
   Updated various translations


Campaign Updates:

   Improved Skip One and Skip All Dialog functionalities
   Fixed dialog sizes and animations
   Improved objective highlights
   Fixed character image display
   Updated various translations


Faction Updates:

   Implemented Factions to different map types.
   Added missing translations

notes.title: Early Access Regular Update
notes.notes:
Hello Knight,
We are here with another update with some bug fixes and general improvements. Have fun!

Bug fixes

 Fixed units returning to trees in desert maps
 Fixed UI problems happening after playing tutorial games
 Fixed units shown as tired on undo after merge


Improvements

 Added skip all Campaign dialog option on ESC hold
 Updated tutorial translations
 Fixed various UI text sizing problems on different localizations
 Rearranged UI elements to improve visibility

notes.title: Early Access Regular Update
notes.notes:
Hello Knights,
We are happy to announce our second patch notes including improvements in localization and gameplay. Have fun!

Localization Updates

 Added support to match game language to Steam language on first open.
 Added German language support
 Added missing title and in-game text translations
 Updated incorrect translations

  
Gameplay Improvements

 Fixed various problems caused by real-time order animation
   Updated Campaign level 6/7/8 maps
   Fixed town center placement logic
   Improved Bot order handling logic


UI/UX Improvements

 Added objective highlights to Campaign mode
   Fixed localization text size resizing
   Added language selection option to settings

notes.title: Politon will release into Early Access on August 23rd, 2023!
notes.notes:
Why Early Access?

Player feedback is crucial for us to make Politon the best it can be. Although we are very close to the full version, we want to see our shortcomings based on player opinions and continue our development accordingly. Throughout this process, we will be adding more content, improvements, and visual enhancements to all planned game modes. Joining us early will allow you to express your ideas for the full version and enjoy early good experiences in the world of Politon.

Features available in Early Access

Online Multiplayer (Play with Steam friends)
Single Player Scenario
Online Challenges
Single Player Skirmish

Have fun knights!
